create_RuleLibrary: create a RuleLibrary instance to store learned rules and their confidence statistics
update_RuleLibrary: update a RuleLibrary with a list of rules and their observed accuracy
save_RuleLibrary: save a RuleLibrary to a YAML file for persistent storage
load_RuleLibrary: load a RuleLibrary from a YAML file to restore learned rules and statistics
create_PromptFunction: create a PromptFunction from a YAML config file to define an LLM-based prompt with optional regex pattern extraction
